citations.assessment: The Bavli verifies the doorway scene, the question, the halakhah, and forty repetitions. Its pronoun sequence is read in the Davidson edition as Zeira learning from Natan.
The Yerushalmi directly attributes the precedence of the afternoon prayer to Natan bar Tovi in the name of R. Yoḥanan.
